nom: P.CALM Underpore Holy Basil Cleansing Oil

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin report the cleansing oil is gentle, does not irritate their skin, and has minimal noticeable smell despite the basil scent.

concerns.spots: Reviewers report the product helps reduce the appearance of blackheads and whiteheads on the nose, with one noting a visible reduction in the size of blackheads and sebaceous filaments.

aspects.libelle: Melts off makeup and sunscreen easily
Works well in a double cleanse routine
Skin feels soft and hydrated after use

extraits.titre: I would definitely buy this product again!
extraits.texte: I love this Cleasning oil really did get rid of my blackheads on my nose was so gentle and not much smell really suitable for sensitive skin and definitely recommend to anyone who has blackheads/whiteheads really best product works the best

This is a great cleansing oil! It smells fresh, just like basil and it easily melts off any makeup or sunscreen that you may have on. After using this I follow up with the P. Calm UnderPore Cleanser to really cleanse my skin. Some cleansing oils are very thick and are hard to wash off during a double cleanse, but I did not have that issue with this cleansing oil. I think this might be my new favorite because it works really well and my skin doesn't feel stripped nor greasy after.

As an avid k-beauty/skincare lover, this cleansing oil has become my holy grail in my night time routine. The scent of basil lingers on my skin but it is a pleasant scent. I love that it does not strip my skin when double cleansing and actually helps reduce the sizes of my blackheads and my sebaceous filaments. This has easily replaced my other oil cleansers and I know it will be one of those products that will eventuallt go viral on TikTok.

I've been using this cleansing oil for a while now, and it's quickly become one of my favorite skincare products! It melts away makeup, sunscreen, and impurities effortlessly without leaving my skin feeling greasy or stripped. After rinsing, my face feels clean, soft, and hydrated. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin or clog my pores, and I love how fresh and smooth my skin looks afterward.

I've been using this cleansing oil for a while now, and I'm so impressed! It melts away makeup, sunscreen, and daily buildup without any harsh scrubbing. My skin feels clean, soft, and hydrated after every use—never tight or stripped. It rinses off beautifully and doesn't leave behind a greasy residue.

reserve: Only five reviews are available, all 5-star, so the sheet has no critical or dissenting feedback and limited coverage across skin types and concerns.
